verses.pali: Atha kho ahiṁsakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then the brahmin Bhāradvāja the Harmless went up to the Buddha, and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho ahiṁsakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, he sat down to one side and said,
“I am Harmless, worthy Gotama, I am Harmless!”

verses.pali: Evaṁ vutte, ahiṁsakabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When he had spoken, the brahmin Bhāradvāja the Harmless said to the Buddha,

verses.pali: Aññataro ca panāyasmā ahiṁsakabhāradvājo arahataṁ ahosīti.
verses.english: And Venerable Bhāradvāja the Harmless became one of the perfected.
